title: Canonical native adic scalar tensor and Hom reindexing data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a scheme isomorphism $g:X\xrightarrow\sim Y$, native normalized realizations $R_X,R_Y$ and their ordinary tensor data of [def-sf-native-adic-realization-data]. Define a coefficient reindexing datum as an isomorphism $g^{-1}R_Y\cong R_X$ in the sectionwise inverse-image model of [def-sf-proetale-sectionwise-module-inverse-image], equal to the identity on the underlying finite-extension-valued continuous functions. Define ordinary module inverse image by this recorded sectionwise module functor with the transported ring action, its exactness by the recorded exactness theorem, and its derived functor by exact termwise derivation. For a finite coefficient field $E$, an integral reindexing datum is a balanced scalar-base-change isomorphism between this module pullback after integral extension to $R_Y$ and integral extension to $R_X$ after the completed integral module inverse image of [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps]. Require it on every pure section to send $a\otimes x$ to the coefficient-reindexed $a\otimes x$. Include a derived base-change isomorphism and require its representative equation through the universal derived-extension cochain counits and the exact inverse-image cochain factorizations. These are definitions, with no existence asserted. The scalar structural map uses [def-sf-native-adic-finite-normalization].
